sourceFacts.description: One open-topped U-outline bucket, with two long vertical sides and a horizontal bottom. A short axial connector descends from the middle of its bottom.

Two long sloping handles terminate in thick rectangular-looking disc profiles. The left profile is inside the bucket without touching its walls and has visible hatching; the right dark profile is to the right, outside the bucket.

Below the bucket are the axial connector, a dark collar/insulation region, a narrow neck and a large round glass-vessel outline with a foot. The conducting axial line reaches a common joint from which two leaves diverge down-left and down-right.

Three plus marks beside the left disc, three minus marks beside the right disc, seven minus marks on the inner bucket outline (three at each side and one near the bottom middle), and four plus marks by the leaves (two by each leaf). These are the printed qualitative symbols, not carrier counts or measured charge ratios.
